widgets_values: One unbroken aerial shot. The camera starts on the person at ground level and rises straight up and back. The person shrinks below as the streets, the city, the coastline and the clouds come into view. The camera passes through a layer of white cloud and keeps rising until the curve of the Earth and the black of space fill the frame. The move is fastest in the middle and slows to almost still in the last second.

widgets_values: The sound is a steady rush of wind with a low rising tone that settles in the last second.

# Effects: one photo to a short effect video on LTX 2.5

Fits your photo to the chosen shape and makes the effect's last frame with Qwen Image Edit 2511, then renders the video between the two on LTX 2.5, with its sound, at the shape's pixel area. This file holds every part a recipe can use, including the subject held through its matte. Each recipe in the Rosesfield catalog removes the parts it does not use.
